phase: Accounting Spine / F4 annual-2025 counterpart stock evidence gate
purpose: Pre-register a fail-closed, source-specific reconciliation rule for a future official BNR CNF 2025 S121 AF4 counterpart-stock matrix. This contract does not claim that the 2025 matrix has been published, does not open the F4 gate, and does not authorize a new source probe before the existing evidence window.

governing_sources.historical_source_precision_note: The reviewed 2024 annual CNF PDF labels the counterpart tables as stocks in million lei and displays integer-valued cells; the retained screening does not identify an explicit rounding rule or source precision metadata. This historical presentation is not evidence of the precision rule applicable to a future 2025 publication.

scope.comparison_boundary: The five RMD counterpart groups H, C, F, G and X within the retained 2025-Q4 F4 stock boundary.

sector_mapping.F: exact additive sum of S122+S123, S124+S125+S126+S127, and S128+S129

scope.self_counterpart_rule: If the publication presents an S121 counterpart column, preserve it as a separately labelled source cell. Do not silently include it in or exclude it from the five-cell 6.1 million RON RMD boundary; resolve any effect against the retained boundary before a trigger can pass.

preconditions: The existing publication-window restriction has been satisfied: no source probe occurs before the window opens after 2026-10-31, and no repeated polling occurs without genuinely new official-publication evidence.
A genuinely official BNR National Financial Accounts 2025 publication or official machine-readable equivalent exposes non-consolidated year-end S121 AF4/F4 asset stocks by counterpart.
All included cells map to the frozen RMD sectors and all unit conversions to million RON are exact and documented.
The target 2025-Q4 F4 control is read from the retained source vintage and its frozen provenance; the control is not replaced by a newly polled or revised value.

The counterpart matrix and the retained control refer to matching instrument, asset/liability, maturity, consolidation, valuation and reference-period concepts. Any unresolved semantic difference blocks the trigger.

precision_evidence_policy.required_for_every_numeric_input: Record the exact source_value and source_unit, a documented positive exact conversion_factor_to_million_RON, source_resolution in source-unit terms, rounding_mode, precision_basis, a source_locator for the reported value, and a distinct precision_evidence_locator identifying official evidence for both the precision and rounding mode. The implementation must calculate normalized values and resolutions from the recorded exact conversion factor. A positive source_resolution is admissible only when official evidence supports rounding_mode = NEAREST at that resolution. A zero source_resolution is admissible only when OFFICIAL_SOURCE_EXACTNESS_STATEMENT is supported at the precision evidence locator and rounding_mode = EXACT.
precision_evidence_policy.forbidden_inference: Never infer precision, accuracy or a reconciliation tolerance solely from the number of decimal places, integer formatting, lexical CSV/JSON representation, observed residuals, or a desired pass result.
precision_evidence_policy.no_official_precision_disposition: If the official 2025 publication offers only values with no usable documented precision/rounding rule, record nonconfirmation only. Do not substitute the historical 2024 presentation format, the Phase A 0.1 million RON T=S+L control, an ECB tolerance from a different gate, or an analyst-selected fixed allowance.

semantic_adjudication.required_evidence_structure: Every required check must be exactly true only after independent source review. semantic_assessment.evidence_locators must contain a non-empty, inspectable source or contract locator for every required check; free-text assertion without a supporting locator is insufficient. Record the semantic assessment before comparing source values, and never infer a semantic check from the observed residual.
semantic_adjudication.numeric_helper_boundary: assess_documented_precision_reconciliation is a numeric primitive only. Its output must not be interpreted as satisfying official-source identity, publication-window, reporting-sector, instrument, accounting-entry, consolidation, valuation, maturity, counterpart coverage, sector mapping, S121 self-counterpart treatment, or frozen-target requirements. Actual source adjudication must use assess_f4_counterpart_reconciliation, which fails closed unless every semantic check and its locator is present.
semantic_adjudication.success_effect: A complete semantic assessment permits only the documented-precision numerical result to be considered eligible for base-trigger adjudication. It does not open F4, materialize cells, or reopen flows or reference modes.
semantic_adjudication.numeric_term_coverage: Before numerical reconciliation, semantic_assessment.expected_term_keys must be a non-empty list of unique stable identifiers for every published source cell that contributes to the frozen H/C/F/G/X sum, including every distinct F subsector input. Each corresponding numeric term must carry exactly one matching non-empty term_key and an individual source_locator; the actual and expected key sets must be identical (no omitted, duplicate, or unregistered extra term). The assessment must also contain expected_target_key, and the target record must carry the identical non-empty target_key identifying the retained frozen 2025-Q4 F4 control. A source-coverage boolean without exact key-set agreement is insufficient.
semantic_adjudication.coefficient_rule: For this counterpart-stock sum, every contributing numeric term must have coefficient exactly +1. Zero, fractional, negative, or other coefficients cannot be used to mask an omitted cell, double-count a cell, or alter the frozen counterpart sum. If the scope later requires another identity, preregister that identity separately before evaluating observed values.

reconciliation_method.arithmetic: Exact decimal/rational arithmetic only; no binary floating-point comparison and no discretionary epsilon.
reconciliation_method.terms: For every published counterpart cell contributing to H, C, F, G or X, retain source_value, source_unit, exact positive conversion_factor_to_million_RON, source_resolution, rounding_mode, precision_basis, source_locator and precision_evidence_locator. Normalize to million RON using exact rational arithmetic. For composite F, include a separate record and resolution contribution for every published financial-subsector column included in the exact additive sum.
reconciliation_method.target: Retain source_value, source_unit, exact positive conversion_factor_to_million_RON, source_resolution, rounding_mode, precision_basis, source_locator and precision_evidence_locator for the frozen 2025-Q4 F4 control. Normalize its value and resolution to million RON using exact rational arithmetic; do not replace it with a newly polled or revised value.
reconciliation_method.rounding_envelope: E = sum_i(abs(a_i) * q_i / 2) + q_y / 2, where q_i and q_y are calculated exactly from each recorded source_resolution multiplied by its documented conversion_factor_to_million_RON. Positive resolutions require official evidence that the associated rounding_mode is NEAREST. A zero source resolution requires OFFICIAL_SOURCE_EXACTNESS_STATEMENT and rounding_mode EXACT.
reconciliation_method.residual: R = sum_i(a_i * x_i) - y, where x_i and y are normalized to million RON by the recorded conversion factors. Calculate values, resolution envelopes and residuals with exact rational arithmetic.
reconciliation_method.pass_condition: The precision portion passes only when every required precision record is valid and abs(R) <= E. No additional tolerance may be added after values are observed.
reconciliation_method.explicit_official_accounting_tolerance: No separate fixed tolerance can replace or supplement the rounding-envelope test under this contract. If an official source establishes a distinct rule for this exact cross-source control, it must be adjudicated and preregistered in a new immutable contract before target values are compared; absent such revision, apply the rounding-envelope rule only.
reconciliation_method.interpretation_of_zero: A published numeric zero remains a reported observation with its documented precision interval; it is not promoted to an exact structural zero unless a separate existing RMD structural-zero contract authorizes that exact conclusion. Missing values remain missing.

authorized_effect_if_this_contract_and_a: Supports adjudication of REOPEN_F4_STOCK_ONLY_EXACT_COUNTERPART_MATERIALIZATION_GATE under the existing frozen F4 trigger. It does not materialize data automatically.

current_disposition.date_semantics: Inherited from the existing F4 monitoring assessment; it is not a promised BNR publication date.
